changelog: New: Public Suno songs download with no Suno login — paste a suno.com/song or suno.com/s link and get the track as M4A (or MP3 when MP3 output is selected)
New: Signing in to Suno (from the Help menu) is now optional and only needed for your own private / unreleased songs
Improved: Pinterest single-Pin downloads now fetch the original image and the highest-quality video directly, handle pin.it short links, and keep the real file type
New: Pinterest boards can be added to the queue — every Pin is enumerated and downloaded through the normal download list
Fixed: Adding a scraped board/profile to the queue no longer stops at the first already-queued item — remaining new items are still added
Fixed: An invalid or expired pin.it / suno.com/s link now reports a clear error instead of grabbing an unrelated item
